On Wednesday afternoon,  Compass  and  Anywhere Real Estate  said  stockholders at both companies “voted overwhelmingly” to approve the merger during special meetings earlier in the day.  Compass shares closed 9.3% higher on Wednesday, marking its highest close since late 2021, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
